title: Unit Event — With Our Wounded Hands — Episode3 Conflicted

meta.Event Outline: Ena hasn't been able to reach Mizuki since the school festival. She doesn't know what the right thing to do is, but her regrets compel her to seek Mizuki out for a heart-to-heart.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want to talk, but I can't get a hold of Mizuki here or in SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, stop blocking the fridge for no reason. I need something out of there, so move.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Are you still having trouble getting ahold of Akiyama...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki still hasn't shown up for school, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I don't know exactly what's going on since we're in different classes, but Akiyama's been gone every time I go over to see Toya during lunch.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I told him to let me know if he sees Akiyama, but nothing so far...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess that's to be expected...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Want me to ask another one of Akiyama's friends?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya probably has the best idea of what's going on, but this other girl's known Akiyama a lot longer. She might've actually gotten word somehow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll arrange a meeting for you two while I'm at it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm...
No, I haven't heard anything...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It did feel a little odd to see Mizuki missing so much school lately.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I've gotten replies back saying, “Still not feeling it, so I'm skipping again,” and such... Which I guess means things are okay?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. At least someone's been able to get in contact...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hang on... Does that mean you haven't been able to get ahold of Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, would you like it if I asked Mizuki to get in touch with you...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If she were to use my name...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki might stop replying to Shiraishi altogether, which would mean...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry, I'll need to give that some more thought.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay.
Feel free to ask again if you need any help!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks, I will.
And sorry for making you meet with me like this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, that's okay! I was also a little worried about Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Not replying to anything I send must mean...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki doesn't want to talk to me.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hello, Shinonome.
It's rare to bump into you at school like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Is something wrong...?
You seem rather concerned.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm thinking about telling them everything...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: About myself. To the others in my group.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you'd like, I'd be more than happy to listen.
